fields.title: Kōgyō Shisetsu Hoshu Meirei Tōgō ni kansuru Kōshiki Tsūchi

notice.subject: Fukusō suru hoshu meirei no tōgō to saishiji
notice.reason: Minkan kōgyō bu to gunji kanri bu no meirei fuguai no kaiketsu.

fields.content: Kore yori, Kobayashi Isamu shi no yōsei ni kotae, ryō bukyoku kara hassō sareta fukusō suru hoshu meirei o tōgō shi, aratana tōgō hoshu keikaku o tekiyō suru koto o tsūchi shimasu.

claims.fact: Kōshiki tsūchi wa fukusō meirei no tōgō to seikyū no ukeire o shōmei shite iru.
